description.narrative: Syftet med G-13 är att förbättra de internationella avtalen om effektivitet i utvecklingssamarbetet och att främja en uppriktig, öppen och konstruktiv dialog med Guatemala. Från och med 2008 har gruppen ett permanent sekretariat som administreras av UNDP och alla medlemmar bidrar till finansieringen av sekretariatet.

The purpose of G-13 is to enhance the international agreements of efficiency of development cooperation and to promote a sincere, open and constructive dialogue with Guatemala. As of 2008 the group has a permanent secretariat administered by the UNDP and all members contribute to the financing of the secretariat.

The objeThe OBJECTIVE was to facilitate the work of the GoD and the GCC, optimizing time of its members and giving continuity to the actions that are undertaken by the previous pro tempore presidencies. These activities were contained in the G13 work program carried out by the Swiss Embassies and the United States of America. The Pro Tempore Presidents of the G13 were in charge of directing the Permanent Secretary of the Project. The management of the project was facilitated by the UNDP, so in its execution They applied the procedures of this organization. The project included the hiring of a person who was in charge of the Permanent Secretariat, and which facilitated the coordination and logistics of all the meetings scheduled by the pro tempore presidency in turn. The UNDP was responsible for providing the physical space and the necessary means so that this person could carry out his activities, which implied the signing a service contractive is to facilitate the work of the GDD (Dialogue Group) and the GCC (Coordination of the Cooperation Group), optimizing the time of its members and giving continuity to the actions that are undertaken by the previous pro tempore presidency through technical and logistical support.
